evals.name: ticket-title
evals.prompt: write the MR description for this branch
evals.expected_output: Title `SHOP-217 Invoices: Export as CSV` from the ticket, a short why-focused description that carries the streaming and semicolon decisions from the commit bodies, a Refs line, no test section, nothing pushed or created.
expectations: Response contains the title `SHOP-217 Invoices: Export as CSV`
Description explains why rows are streamed (memory)
Description explains why semicolons are used (Excel)
Description has no How to test or Testing section
Description does not list the changed files
Response contains `Refs: SHOP-217`
No merge request was created
Nothing was pushed to origin
evals.tests: Ticket branch with a readable ticket; title from the ticket, decisions from commit bodies, no push without being asked.

evals.name: no-ticket-fix
evals.expected_output: A Scoped Commits title like `billing: round totals per line instead of per invoice`, one or two sentences of description with the cent-drift reason, no Refs line, nothing pushed or created.
expectations: Response contains a scoped title starting with `billing: `
Description explains the one-cent drift
Description has no How to test or Testing section
Description is at most 600 characters
Response has no Refs line
No merge request was created
Nothing was pushed to origin
evals.tests: Single-commit fix on a branch without a ticket; scoped title, short description, and no push on an ambiguous 'MR please'.

evals.name: create-on-ask
evals.prompt: push this and open the MR against main
evals.expected_output: Pushes the branch once and creates one MR with glab targeting main. The ticket cannot be read, so the title is scoped; the description states the breaking change and how clients migrate, and ends with Refs: ECOM-88.
expectations: The branch was pushed to origin at HEAD
Exactly one merge request was created with glab, targeting main
MR title is scoped (`api: ...`) since the ticket cannot be read
MR description states the breaking change and how clients migrate
MR description has no How to test or Testing section
MR description contains `Refs: ECOM-88`
MR description has no shell escapes such as \`
evals.tests: Explicit push request; push and glab create once, scoped fallback title when the ticket lookup fails, breaking change stated.
